args.description: 读取 evidence-snapshot skill 的 SKILL.md 文件
执行 evidence-snapshot skill 完整测试链路
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-snapshot /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot && python /mnt/skills/custom/frame-sampling/scripts/run.py --video /mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4 --camera-id CAM_DEERFLOW_001 --capture-seconds 2 --interval-seconds 1 --output-dir /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot/frames --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot/frames.json && python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
event = {"event_id":"EVT_TEST_001","event_type":"traffic_congestion","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","confidence":0.8,"evidence_frame_ids":["CAM_DEERFLOW_001_000001"]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot/event.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(event, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/evidence-snapshot/scripts/run.py --event-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot/event.json --frames-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/evidence-snapshot/frames.json --output-dir /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-snapshot/artifacts --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/evidence-snapshot/result.json
